device_name: CoRoent Small Interlock 2 Titanium Plasma-Sprayed PEEK ACDF Spacer

specs.By Material: Titanium Coated PEEK , Titanium Plasma Sprayed , PEEK Solid block

description: The CoRoent Small Interlock 2 Titanium plasma-sprayed PEEK ACDF  spacer is a no-profile implant designed for reduced surgical exposure, number of implants, and simplified implantation procedure. The circumferential locking ledge with visible triangle laser marks within the screw hole provide both tactile and visual confirmation of the locking mechanism. The plasma-sprayed titanium coated PEEK interbody provides the bony on-growth benefit of titanium while maintaining the stiffness and radiolucency of traditional PEEK.
features: Radiolucent PEEK body with plasma-sprayed titanium coating
